title: Four Triangle Restaurants Make Yelp's Top 100 Indian Restaurants in America
excerpt: Lime & Lemon in Chapel Hill leads the Triangle at No. 18 on Yelp's national list, followed by Bombay Curry, Masala House and Mustang House in Raleigh.
body:
• Four Triangle restaurants appear on Yelp's Top 100 Indian restaurants in the United States: Lime & Lemon (Chapel Hill) at No. 18, Bombay Curry at No. 41, Masala House at No. 65 and Mustang House at No. 72, the last three in Raleigh.
  • North Carolina placed eight restaurants on the national list in total, including Curry Gate in Charlotte at No. 32 and Curry and Noodle in Winston-Salem at No. 100.
  • Yelp built the ranking from customer ratings and the volume of reviews left over time; the national No. 1 is LA Indian Cuisine in Castaic, California.
  • Butter chicken and samosas are among the most popular dishes on the Yelp pages of both Masala House and Mustang House, the News & Observer reported.

Four Indian restaurants in the Triangle have been ranked among the best in the country. Yelp's Top 100 Indian restaurants list, released on Thursday, October 29, places Lime & Lemon Indian Grill & Bar in Chapel Hill at No. 18, and three Raleigh restaurants — Bombay Curry at No. 41, Masala House at No. 65 and Mustang House at No. 72 — further down a list drawn from diners' ratings and reviews, the Raleigh News & Observer reported.

The four, and where they are

Lime & Lemon's ranked location is in Chapel Hill's Meadowmont Village shopping center, and the chain has locations in several parts of the Triangle. Its customers praised the bright decor and flavors, the News & Observer reported, and the restaurant describes its menu as dishes that take diners on a journey through India's regions, traditions and festivals. Bombay Curry, on Strickland Road in North Raleigh, stood out in Yelp reviews for customer service and portion sizes — and it carries a second national distinction: in 2024 it was named the nation's favorite place for Indian takeout on DoorDash.

Masala House is on East Millbrook Road in Raleigh, and Mustang House is on Fayetteville Street in downtown Raleigh. For both, butter chicken and samosas are among the most popular dishes listed on their Yelp pages.

How the list was built

Yelp said the list "highlights the most-loved spots in the U.S. for classic and trending Indian flavors." The ranking is based on factors including the total volume of reviews and the ratings customers left over time, USA Today reported — a diner-driven measure, not a critics' list. The national No. 1 is LA Indian Cuisine in Castaic, Southern California, and Mumbai House in Park City, Utah, is No. 2.

"highlights the most-loved spots in the U.S. for classic and trending Indian flavors"

— Yelp, on its Top 100 Indian restaurants list

North Carolina beyond the Triangle

The Triangle's four are half of the state's showing. North Carolina placed eight restaurants on the list: alongside the Triangle entries are Curry Gate in Charlotte at No. 32, Curry Palace in Burlington at No. 67, Mehfil in Asheville at No. 76 and Curry and Noodle in Winston-Salem at No. 100. For Triangle readers, the practical takeaway is a ranked shortlist close to home — start at Lime & Lemon in Chapel Hill, and work down through three Raleigh kitchens that local diners have already rated into the national top 100.
